articles.title: Kraken adds S&P 500 to funded trading program, commodities to follow
articles.description: Kraken’s funded trading program adds round-the-clock exposure to the US equity benchmark as it builds out its multi-asset offering.

articles.title: Grubhub’s $24M FTC settlement is finally reaching diners and drivers
articles.description: Checks are being mailed from Grubhub's $23.8 million fine from  the FTC after it settled allegations over its business practices.

articles.title: AI coding startup Cognition reportedly already in talks to raise at $40B valuation
articles.description: Cognition may be looking to raise another mega round just a few months after raising $1 billion at a $26 billion valuation.

articles.title: Bitwise cuts 14% of staff while still expecting growth
articles.description: Crypto companies from including Coinbase, BitGo, Robinhood, Polygon and Pump.fun have announced workforce reductions this year, citing a variety of reasons, including shifting to AI and market forces.

articles.title: As AI safety concerns mount, three pioneers make the case for staying open
articles.description: At Ai4, three of the world's most respected AI experts—Geoffrey Hinton, Fei-Fei Li, and Andrew Ng—debated regulation, open-source access, and how America can compete as China advances in Asia.

articles.title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings raises $2B to bring AI to the enterprise
articles.description: Thrive Holdings has raised $2 billion in new funding at a $12 billion valuation from investors like SoftBank, D1 Capital Partners, and Altimeter Capital.

articles.title: Goldman Sachs leaps into bitcoin income ETFs with $2.25 billion NEOS buyout
articles.description: The $2.25 billion deal expands Goldman’s derivative platform to $130 billion in total ETF assets, taking direct aim at BlackRock's rival BITA fund, according to an analyst.

articles.title: Uber Freight reportedly investigating after hacking group claims data breach
articles.description: An extortion gang known for targeting transportation companies and private equity firms has taken credit for a breach at Uber Freight.

articles.title: FlightAware drops Kalshi lawsuit one day after filing
articles.description: Following the initial lawsuit, at least one of Kalshi’s event contracts was changed to list “Primary Source Agency” as the entity behind verifying flight cancellation data.

articles.title: Mesh, Automattic’s CRM for everyone, comes to Android
articles.description: Mesh, an AI-powered contacts app and relationship manager from Automattic, is now an Android app.

articles.title: Bank of England tests stablecoin, digital pound interoperability in cross-border payments
articles.description: The Digital Pound Lab is testing a cross-border trade finance flow combining stablecoin payments with simulated digital pound settlement.

articles.title: Wintermute plans $1 billion AI push beyond crypto: Bloomberg
articles.description: The firm aims for non-crypto markets to drive over 50% of revenue by 2027, up from 10% currently, as it seeks to diversify its business.

articles.title: Tesla wants to build a $10B solar factory in Texas
articles.description: Tesla wants to build a massive solar factory in Texas, but first it wants the state to chip in to defray the costs.

articles.title: Lovable confirms new $13.3B valuation, raises another $400M

articles.title: Facebook officially rolls out its stand-alone Creator Studio app with AI tools for creators
articles.description: The new app launches with Facebook's AI creator assistant built into it, providing creators with personalized recommendations based on their content style, performance, audience engagement, and goals.
